business_rationale: Largest single transfer this week is in the top 1% of all development-period transfer amounts.
limitations: AMLSim caps amounts near 600, so 'large' has a narrow meaning; typology transfers are not larger.

business_rationale: Weekly transaction count in the top 1% of development account-weeks.
limitations: Absolute counts penalise legitimately busy accounts; simulation volume varies by week.

business_rationale: (this week's count + 1) / (historical weekly mean + 1) in the top 1%; account must have history.
limitations: Needs history; unstable for accounts with very few past transactions.

business_rationale: Number of counterparties never seen before this week in the top 1%.
limitations: Almost every AMLSim background transfer goes to a new counterparty, so novelty is common.

business_rationale: log(mean amount this week / historical median amount) in the top 1% (larger than usual). Requires >= 5 historical transactions. QUARANTINED: perfect development precision traced to artifact A1 (tiny typology amounts deflate the account's own baseline, so ordinary amounts look like escalation).
limitations: Partly driven by the sub-100 typology amounts (artifact A1) inflating/deflating baselines.

business_rationale: Activity after > 4 empty weeks. Evaluated but EXCLUDED: precision below the base rate in development.
limitations: Dormancy is mostly a simulator start/end effect here.

business_rationale: min(in/out balance of 28-day flows, share of outflow sent within 3 days of an inflow) in the top 1%.
limitations: Step granularity is one day; intra-day ordering of in/out flows is unknown.

business_rationale: Two or more transfers to the same receiver in one week (structuring-like). EXCLUDED from the framework: in AMLSim background activity never repeats a receiver within a week, so this rule's perfect precision is a simulator artifact, not transferable evidence.
limitations: Simulator artifact (A2/A3): background accounts never repeat a receiver within a week.

business_rationale: Account lies on >= 1 time-respecting directed cycle (3-6 accounts) within 28 days.
limitations: Random background activity also forms time-respecting cycles; cycles are rare overall.

business_rationale: Distinct senders over 28 days in the top 1% (many-to-one).
limitations: Legitimate collection accounts (e.g. merchants) would also trigger; no account-type field exists.

business_rationale: Distinct receivers over 28 days in the top 1% (one-to-many).
limitations: Legitimate payout accounts (e.g. payroll) would also trigger; no account-type field exists.

business_rationale: Amount-weighted PageRank in the 28-day graph in the top 1% (where money accumulates).
limitations: Highly correlated with fan-in and inflow value; adds little independent evidence.
